name: seis-repository-scorecard
description: Read-only local repository scorecard based on evidence files and bounded metadata.

interface.shortDescription: Score local repository readiness without popularity signals.
interface.longDescription: Produces a deterministic, read-only scorecard from local repository metadata, documentation, security, testing and release evidence. It does not query GitHub or claim production health.
interface.defaultPrompt: Score this local repository using only bounded metadata and explain missing evidence.
